notes.title: Summer and Feedback Update is Now Available!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone, [/p][p]We hope you’ve been enjoying your underwater escape experience with friends and family so far! [/p][p]To start the week with some good news, we’re excited to roll out our first major “Summer & Feedback Update”, packed with bug fixes, many gameplay improvements, and new feedback systems to optimize your co-op interactions. [/p][p]Over the past weeks, our team has been closely watching players from around the world dive into the escape rooms we’ve designed with passion. Thanks to your streams, feedback, and messages, we've crafted a new patch aimed at enhancing the overall experience, and we can’t wait for you to try it.[/p][p]Plus, to celebrate, [b]the game is 25% off until August 17[/b]![/p][p]Scroll down for all the details included in the “Summer & Feedback Update 1.3.0”[/p][h2]Gameplay Improvements & Update[/h2][p][b]Global[/b][/p][list][*][p]New sound effects added[/p][/*][*][p]Localization updates across various languages[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Main Game[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now invert the Y-axis when playing with a mouse or gamepad[/p][/*][*][p]For Chinese players: the intro QR code now redirects to a website that doesn't require a VPN to access the Companion App[/p][/*][*][p]New feedback has been added when entering a code on a keypad[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Rescue Submarine[/b][/p][list][*][p]Levers: Success feedback added. notes.title: How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine is now available!
notes.notes: [p]We’re proud to announce that the highly anticipated new chapter in the [b]How 2 Escape series is finally available on PC and consoles![/b][/p][h2]Watch the Launch Trailer![/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="SzgVOFSZcHE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]If you haven’t played the first game, no worries! How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine is a unique co-op puzzle adventure where you and a friend will team up to reach a lost submarine and prevent the outbreak of war. [/p][p]Work together on two devices to solve increasingly challenging puzzles, where each of you has your own unique role to play. Communication is key![/p][p]And YES! notes.title: Join our Developer Stream for Next Fest
notes.notes:
Join us for a special 30-minute stream as we dive into How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine — a tense, 2-player co-op escape-room adventure where only one copy is needed thanks to the free companion app! 

Meet two members of our indie team from France and hear how we’re bringing a fresh twist to the puzzle genre we love. 

🧩 Try the free demo now on Steam, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch 
🗓️ Launches June 24, 2025 
📱 Play with a friend on PC or mobile using the free companion app 
💚 Wishlist or pre-order to support the project!

notes.title: How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine Launches June 24
notes.notes:
[h1]Mark your calendars: How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine launches on [b]June 24th[/b]! [/h1]

The latest entry in the How 2 Escape series throws you and a partner into a high-stakes mission to locate a missing submarine and prevent the outbreak of a global war. With only your wits—and each other—you’ll need to work together to solve puzzles, crack codes, and escape before time runs out. 

[h2]Watch the Launch Trailer [/h2]
 
Get a personalized look into How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine from the development team in this new trailer.  

[previewyoutube=GdYPlPtHXRE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What to Expect [/h2]

[list]
[*] Co-op puzzle solving with a friend 
[*] Cross-platform play across two devices 
[*] Only one copy needed! Your partner can download the free companion app on PC or mobile 
[*] Increasingly challenging and immersive puzzles 
[*] Simple, intuitive controls for all players 
[/list]

[h2]Try it now – the demo is available today! [/h2]
 Jump in early and get a taste of the tension and teamwork that define How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine. 

Grab your partner. Load up your comms. And get ready to dive deep. 

👉 Wishlist now and download the demo to get started! 

 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3530680/How_2_Escape_Lost_Submarine/

notes.title: Experience a Unique Puzzle Co-Op Adventure in How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine
notes.notes:
[h2]Welcome to How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine! [/h2]

A unique co-op puzzle game where you and a friend will team up to reach a lost submarine and prevent the outbreak of war. Work together on two devices to solve increasingly challenging puzzles, where each of you has your own unique role to play.

[previewyoutube=ssV2PNmXuEQ;full][/previewyoutube]
How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine will be available in 2025 on Steam and consoles. 
With the game, there will be a free companion app for player 2 that will be available on PC (Steam), Android and iOS. 
A free companion app?
Yes! In “How 2 Escape”, you’ll have to team up with a friend! 
Invite someone to play with you for free and enjoy this unique co-op experience.
If you aren’t familiar with the How 2 Escape concept, feel free to have a look at our first episode, that is currently on sale to celebrate the latest announcement!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2264140/How_2_Escape/

[h2]Wishlist How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine today: [/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3530680/How_2_Escape_Lost_Submarine/
You can already discover more about the stories and the first screenshots and storyline on our Steam Page!
We cannot wait to welcome you in the “How 2 Escape” universe!
Breakfirst & Maximum Entertainment teams
